items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It’s interesting, Michael Jackson has used you quite a bit for things of that nature, Prince uses Clare Fischer.

ctx.x: If I had to but I don’t like it and I’ll usually turn down projects like that if I can help it. Or limit the string writing into registers where they won’t sound too terrible with a small section.
It’s interesting, Michael Jackson has used you quite a bit for things of that nature, Prince uses Clare Fischer.
